prompt: We just removed the last Node.js dependency from this Worker; src/ only uses web APIs now. Turn Node.js compatibility off for this Worker completely, so that node: modules and Node globals are not available at all and nothing Node-related can sneak back into the bundle. Keep the current compatibility date.
trap: From compatibility date 2026-08-04 Workers turn on nodejs_compat and nodejs_compat_v2 by default, so just deleting the nodejs_compat flag (or adding only no_nodejs_compat) leaves Node.js compatibility on; both no_nodejs_compat and no_nodejs_compat_v2 are needed.
